<!-- Keep visible content under ~120 lines; use plain characters, not HTML entities, and no first-person narration. -->
<!-- Use a Conventional Commit PR title with a scope, such as feat(dashboard): ...; repository documentation uses docs: ... . -->
<!-- Put a blank line before and after every <details>, </summary>, and fenced code block. -->

## Intent

<!-- State the plain-language goal in 1-2 sentences. No speaker labels or tool/model names. -->

## Summary

<!-- Write 3-4 sentences explaining the user-facing or engineering outcome and why it matters. -->

## What changed

<!-- Use short, grouped bullets describing meaningful changes without implementation trivia. -->

## Why

<!-- Explain the need or problem, not a list of commits. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- Omit this entire section for non-UI changes. Include before/after, light/dark and mobile/desktop screenshots where relevant. -->
<!-- Agents: save screenshots locally with a manifest and list them here as pending; firstmate attaches them to this description. Do not use gists or commit images. -->

## How to review

<!-- Omit this entire section for test-only PRs. Otherwise give 3-5 concrete things to click or check, including expected results. -->

## How it was tested

<!-- Briefly list checks, counts, and scenarios actually exercised, plus failures or limits. Keep detailed evidence below. For non-UI changes include: no user-visible change - screenshots not applicable -->

## Risk

<!-- Describe material risks, limitations, and mitigations, or state that risk is low and explain why. -->

## Compliance

<!-- Always retain and explicitly fill all four visible bullets. Confirm None or replace it with N/A or the applicable facts. -->

- **Figures changed:** None. <!-- If a reported/filed figure changes, provide a before/after table in this PR. -->
- **Rule basis:** None. <!-- For regulatory logic, name the instrument, paragraph, and in-force/draft status. -->
- **Data, privacy and security:** None. <!-- Describe personal/bank data, logging/retention, access, or encryption changes. -->
- **Compliance items:** None. <!-- Name affected IDs from readiness epic #469 and its sub-epics. -->

## Follow-ups

<!-- Link issues for remaining work, or state that there are no follow-ups. -->
